newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU to take United States to WTO over Helms-Burton.
newsitem.headline: EU to take United States to WTO over Helms-Burton.

text.p: The European Union will formally escalate a dispute with the United States over its Helms-Burton trade laws, formally challenging them before the World Trade Organisation, the EU's Irish presidency said on Tuesday.
"They will take the complaint to the WTO on October 16," said an Irish diplomat, speaking during a meeting of European Union foreign ministers on Tuesday.
The move came as a surprise, as many analysts had expected the EU not to step up its retaliation to Washington's Helms-Burton Act until after the U.S. presidential elections in November.
The EU has been at odds with the U.S. over the Act, which seeks to punish businesses trading with Cuba.
The EU has been considering a raft of retaliatory measures, and escalating the dispute with the WTO was considered the most dramatic.
